details: Sole developer on a language and discourse research project (C6354, School of Philology), implementing the analysis design defined by a linguistics PhD.
Built Python pipelines that collected, extracted and segmented 7,063 Legislative Assembly session transcripts (~17 GB) into a traceable corpus.

Building a benchmark of Spanish part-of-speech taggers, from pretrained pipelines (Stanza, spaCy) to a fine-tuned transformer language model (BETO), with a strict EAGLES evaluator and 67 automated tests; SLURM jobs prepared for UCR's A100 GPU cluster.
Building the project's bilingual website (Astro, TypeScript) and user guides so the research team can edit its content without programming.

Built a workload & work-shift declaration platform, as part of an academic assistance program, that replaced a paper-based process for 50+ staff: employees declare shift functions, licenses and rest periods while admins manage the university's organizational hierarchy.
React 19 + TypeScript SPA (Vite, Material UI) with client-side PDF export of declarations.

Framework-less REST API in PHP 8.4 on Oracle Database with a clean layered architecture (controllers, services, PDO/OCI repositories with prepared statements); optimized slow queries from ~4 s to under 1 s.
Token auth with refresh-token rotation, bcrypt, per-IP rate limiting and account lockout; Dockerized monorepo with CI (lint, build, PHPStan) and endpoint and concurrency tests.
Designed, built and shipped websites for 10+ clients across legal (VM Legal Group), hospitality and e-commerce.
Mostly React-based; own the full delivery cycle: requirements, development, deployment, SEO and analytics.
Ongoing support: troubleshoot site outages, broken forms and email delivery issues, configure email, DNS, SSL and hosting migrations, and train clients to update their own content.
Turned four years of CNP (Consejo Nacional de Producción) price bulletins into a clean dataset of 9,184 records across 56 agricultural products.
Cleaned, normalized, and structured the data for PostgreSQL and Django integration.
Implemented dynamic visualizations for historical price analysis across multiple fairs.
Joint academic project between Universidad de Costa Rica and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).
Designed a QR-based computer sign-in workflow to replace manual device registration, as part of an academic assistance program.
Identified requirements through interviews with faculty, security staff and students.
Built a working demo with backend services, a web interface, authentication and role-based access, and presented it for validation.
Developed and maintained the hotel website using Wix and custom JavaScript.
Improved SEO strategy, site structure, and metadata to increase online visibility.
Optimized user experience and booking accessibility through UI improvements.
Monitored site analytics to guide performance and engagement enhancements.
